blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.productTag` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method creates a product tag. It sends a request to the 
[Create Product Tag](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#product-tags\_postproducttags)
API route.
